sources.name: CASIMIR
sources.relationship_notes: The current Hugging Face dataset card declares MIT. Keep redistribution disabled pending review of the dataset card/version, upstream OpenReview article rights, and any third-party content terms. The paper describes 15,646 scientific articles and revision histories. Do not assume the repository license clears all underlying article text.

sources.name: ParaRev
sources.relationship_notes: The current dataset card declares CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Non-commercial and share-alike conditions apply; verify attribution and downstream compatibility before reuse or redistribution. ParaRev is extracted from CASIMIR, so track source lineage and deduplicate overlap rather than counting records as independent.
